revisions.name: $handle_PeekMessageA_fetch
revisions.reason: Review 20261127 timer cancellation contract: PM_NOREMOVE requests USER timer generation mode 2. The scanner snapshots hwnd/id/TIMERPROC under LOCK_WND, advances the period, releases the lock, then retains that MSG in the existing owning-thread USER queue. KillTimer and replacement stop/reset future generation without retracting the queued snapshot. DispatchMessage continues to use MSG.lParam, with unchanged EIP targets, callback frames, stdcall restoration and ownership writes. Readiness probes remain nonconsuming; multimedia one-shots still retire only on removal. Public guest thunk regression covers NULL/window timers, repeated peeks, cross-thread nonconsumption, cancellation before/after generation, replacement deadlines and both old/new real x86 callback dispatch after cancellation; multimedia peek/remove also passes. General callback ownership remains pending.
